note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Water-affected systems are not energised without licensed clearance, even when they appear switched off.
The NSW release advises avoiding damaged appliances until an electrician or plumber declares them safe.

practicalCriteria: The learner keeps water-affected systems de-energised and refers them.
The learner refuses to isolate, reconnect or test any system.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A water-affected system is found or suspected.
A system would be energised or repaired without licensed clearance.
